description: Self-contained todo (checkbox) list item. Owns its JS keyboard-handler lifecycle. Checkbox click fires OnCheckedChanged so the parent persists the new IsChecked value. Enter on an empty item fires OnTypeConvert("paragraph"). Enter on a non-empty item fires OnEnterSplit to create a new sibling todo.

parameters.name: OnAssigneeChanged
parameters.description: Fired when the todo assignee changes. Args = assignee ID and display name.

parameters.name: OnCheckedChanged
parameters.description: Fired when the checkbox is toggled. Arg = new checked state.

parameters.name: OnContentSaved
parameters.description: Fired on blur when HTML has changed. Arg = new HTML.

parameters.name: OnDeleteRequested
parameters.description: Fired when Backspace is pressed on an empty item.

parameters.name: OnDueDateChanged
parameters.description: Fired when the todo due date changes. Arg = selected due date or null.

parameters.name: OnEnterSplit
parameters.description: Fired when Enter is pressed on a non-empty item. Arg = HTML after the split point.

parameters.name: OnMergeWithPrevious
parameters.description: Raised when Backspace is pressed at the start of a non-empty block. The payload is the block's current, sanitized HTML, which the previous block absorbs before this one is deleted.

parameters.name: OnStructuredPaste
parameters.description: Raised when pasted HTML carries more than one block element. The payload is the raw clipboard HTML; the consumer turns it into page blocks.

parameters.name: OnFocused
parameters.description: Fired when the editable receives focus.

parameters.name: OnMentionMenu
parameters.description: Fired when '@' is typed. Args = (top, left) caret coords.

parameters.name: OnPageLinkMenu
parameters.description: Fired when '[[' is typed. Args = (top, left) caret coords.

parameters.name: OnSlashMenu
parameters.description: Fired when '/' is typed. Args = (top, left) caret coords.

parameters.name: OnTokenMenu
parameters.description: Fired when '{{' token syntax is typed. Args = (top, left) caret coords.

parameters.name: OnTypeConvert
parameters.description: Fired when a markdown or conversion shortcut is detected. Special value "paragraph" means the user pressed Enter on an empty item.
